services.name: Buckhead and Downtown Atlanta
services.desc: 30 minutes About This helicopter tour of Atlanta is our most popular tour! We depart Prestige Helicopters and take you to the north side of Buckhead as we make our way to the Governor's Mansion, which is surrounded by some of the largest and most beautiful homes in Atlanta. From there we will take you to Midtown over Atlantic Station to Georgia Tech and The Georgia Aquarium. Then we take a leisurely pass over Centennial Olympic Park, CNN and The Georgia Dome before visiting Turner Field and The State Capitol. Next, it's time to cruise through some of the Most Popular! • 30 minutes

services.name: Chattahoochee River and Buckhead
services.desc: Buckhead and Downtown Atlanta 20 minutes About One of the things that makes Atlanta unique is it's good balance of urban Architecture and Naturalistic Landscapes. This tour combines a bit of both. Start by taking a lap around the Buckhead skyline, buzzing the tops of the skyscrapers. Then head over to the Chattahoochee River and check out all of the historic estates that line the the banks of the river. Next enjoy the view from the air over the Vinings and Cumberland Overlook areas. Finally, check out Suntrust Park, the new home of The Atlanta Braves! When there is not a Braves home 20 Minutes

quotes.author: Kennedy B
quotes.text: Vance was great! He made sure to describe everything we were seeing, and the ride was great! Everything was smooth from booking to landing the helicopter! My boyfriend and I went to celebrate his 21st birthday, and our helicopter tour made it the best birthday ever! The view is unrivaled. I highly recommend the tour, especially with Vance!

quotes.author: Jeff W
quotes.text: Lauren was our pilot. My girlfriend and I went as a surprise on a very windy day. Lauren was great and never made us feel unsafe and handled the ups and downs great. My girlfriend was already nervous but his confidence helped make the trip awesome. I recommend this service highly. Great views, great experience.

quotes.author: Amaris C
quotes.text: The Buckhead tour was fantastic and informative. We timed our flight to perfectly see the sunset. The pilot was very friendly. I’d recommend these services to others.

quotes.author: Teneke M
quotes.text: Had an amazing time riding in a helicopter. Mike was on time, knowledgeable and gave us great photo opportunities. Would definitely do it again!

quotes.author: TPines
quotes.text: Had a Discovery Flight and Mr. Michael was the instructor. He was fantastic and informative. The flight was enjoyable and we will return.

quotes.author: Luis M
quotes.text: It was an incredible experience, excellent service, a good way to celebrate the wedding anniversary from above
